newsitem.title: CANADA: Eaton sells site stake to TD arm, Fairview.
newsitem.headline: Eaton sells site stake to TD arm, Fairview.

text.p: Embattled retailer Eaton's said on Wednesday it sold its 20 percent stake in retail landmark Toronto Eaton Center to the other owners Toronto-Dominion Realty Ltd and real estate firm Cadillac Fairview Corp.

The buyers will pay C$75.5 million in cash and assume the site's C$39 million debt. Eaton's is owned by Canadian retailer T. Eaton Co Ltd, which put the venerable chain under court protection from its creditors on February 27 and was expected to deliver a restructuring plan by mid-June.
The lease for Eaton's flagship store in the center would be extended for 10 years to 2017, it said.
